The Journey · a documentary in chapters

Thirty years of hoarding

Nemo Gould, born Minneapolis 1975, raised in Nevada City, trained in Kansas City and Berkeley, resident artist at the San Francisco dump. The short film first; then the chapters, each with the pieces it produced.

Commissions page template · ready for the menu

Build one for you

A commission starts with your story — who it's for, what it should do when someone touches it — and ends with a machine that tells it. Five stations, in order.

Find

Scrap yards, thrift stores, dumpsters. The right typewriter case can take a year to turn up.

Sort

Everything cleaned, stripped and shelved by type in the Oakland studio. The system is the work.

Weld

Found aluminum TIG-welded and sanded seamless. No casting — every curve was once something else.

Wire

Motors, panel meters, LEDs, hand-crank generators. Salvaged, repaired, given a new job.

Animate

A crank, a button, a motion sensor. It isn't finished until it does something when you touch it.
